> @copilot fix all

All 4 review comments addressed in `4271613`:

1. **Type reuse** — `NamedListView.userFilters` now uses `ListViewSchema['userFilters']` instead of inline duplication
2. **ROADMAP accuracy** — Entry updated to reference `_userFilters` in `buildDataSection` (matching actual implementation)
3. **showAllRecords default** — Checkbox uses `!== false` to match runtime behavior where `showAllRecords` defaults to enabled
4. **Discrete field filtering** — Field picker only shows select/boolean types or fields with explicit options (text/number/date fields excluded since they render empty popovers at runtime)
